name: EFF-Chemical-Constraints-v1-diagnostic
claim: Differentiable preservation of coordinate constraints explicitly declared by the inference ligand. V1 covers heavy-atom-observable tetrahedral and E/Z stereochemistry; it does not infer a conformer, binding orientation, strain, or protein interaction.

functional_form.double_bond_alignment: q = reference_cos_sign * cos(dihedral(stereo_atom_a, bond_a, bond_b, stereo_atom_b))

provenance.status: Opt-in diagnostic pending internal validation; zero runtime scale preserves historical guidance runs.
provenance.information_boundary: Only explicit inference-ligand graph/isomeric-SMILES declarations may define the desired state.
provenance.reference: Sanitized production-inference ligand conformer supplies only the sign/magnitude realization of declared stereo. No crystal coordinates or benchmark outcome are used.
provenance.v1_scope: Explicit atom chirality and explicit E/Z bonds whose defining atoms remain in the heavy-atom graph.
